title: Anonymous FTP Enabled
description: Anonymous FTP allows unauthenticated users to connect and potentially upload or download files. If misconfigured, it may be used for exfiltration or hosting malicious content.
businessImpact: Moderate --- anonymous access may leak confidential business files or allow attackers to place malicious content; depending on write permissions, it could also enable persistence.
remediation:
- Disable anonymous FTP access or restrict to read-only directories.
- Migrate to authenticated, logged protocols (SFTP/HTTPS).
- Restrict upload permissions and monitor file activity.
- Harden FTP configurations and enforce network ACLs.
